method: Links below identify actual archival collections, series or objects. No restricted assets were downloaded, and access permission is not described as an open licence.

records.title: Cyan collection
records.description: Production and company-history videotapes, audio recordings, interviews and promotional material retained by Cyan.
records.rights: Collection conditions allow attribution-based research and educational reproduction of non-restricted material to the extent Cyan controls the rights. Credit Cyan and VGHF. Other rights and restricted records remain outside that permission. Not CC0 or a blanket open licence.

records.title: Myst, estimated 1992-1994
records.description: Specific Myst series within the Cyan collection; useful for distinguishing production evidence from later retrospective summaries.
records.rights: See Cyan collection conditions; estimated archival dates are not asserted release dates.

records.title: Myst promotion, 1993
records.description: An identified digital record of promotional material associated with Myst.
records.rights: See Cyan collection conditions; no media file is included by this bibliography.

records.title: Riven: The Sequel to Myst
records.description: Digital record linked to the Riven series of production materials in the Cyan collection.

records.title: The Making of Riven documentary
records.description: The catalogued making-of documentary record, rather than an unrelated third-party video upload.

records.title: Myst II Ultimatte Day 1 Reel 1, Tay, with timecode
records.description: A named VHS dub of a composite feed, useful as evidence of the production process behind live-action imagery.

records.title: Myst II Audio Session: Riven ADR recording session
records.description: A specific Betacam SP record of dialogue recording, not a general collection homepage.

records.title: Myst 3D gameplay footage and Atrus filming behind the scenes
records.description: Named miniDV production record for the transition to real-time Myst imagery.

records.title: Mark Flitman papers
records.description: Producer records including development documents, property guidelines, business material and correspondence.
records.rights: VGHF's record permits publication of non-restricted material with attribution to Mark Flitman and VGHF, while explicitly noting it does not control all intellectual-property rights. Restricted builds and sensitive documents are excluded. No media imported.

records.title: FromSoftware promotional material collection
records.description: A collector-donated archive of press and promotional materials, including media from Japanese and international releases.
records.rights: The collection record distinguishes donor permission and FromSoftware approval for archival ingestion from permission to reuse individual items. Do not convert that distinction into a blanket open licence. Bibliographic links only.

records.title: Dark Souls I promotional sub-series
records.description: A specific sub-series linked to the FromSoftware promotional collection.
records.rights: Bibliographic reference only; individual media rights require separate review.

records.title: Hardwareklassik: From Odyssey to Xbox
records.description: An actual online hardware exhibition index with dated, named machine entries and curatorial context.
records.rights: Copyright retained by the museum; link and original bibliographic summary only. Individual old database detail links currently return a database connection error, so they are not advertised as working object pages.

records.title: From Computer Space to Pong: virtual guided tour
records.description: Object-specific visitor interpretation of the museum's arcade display and its physical setting.
records.rights: Copyright retained by the museum; bibliographic reference only.
records.curatorial_note: The page contains a problematic Brown Box date. Use it for object/display context; do not import that date over independently verified chronology.

records.title: Computer Games: Evolution of a Medium — permanent exhibition
records.description: Specific exhibition record describing the relationship between original machines, living-room settings, an arcade and interactive game-history displays.
records.rights: Copyright retained by the museum; link and original bibliographic summary only.
